title: Change every item
summary: Haskell: Change every item. Multiply by 3 instead.
introduction: map applies a function to each list item and returns a new list.

blocks.text: Install GHC. Save one example as lesson.hs and run runghc lesson.hs. Keep any definitions above main in the same file.
The expression (* 2) is a function. map applies it to both list items.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: The original list is a value and is not changed in place.
